{{Quote|I was the eye of the Archon on Nar Shaddaa, and provided more than one lightsaber for his collection.|Vorjok|<ref name="HC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Vorjok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] enforcer for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Galactic War]]. After the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]], Vorjok was posted to guard the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] stockpile of [[Isotope-5]] in the [[Stronghold One]] on [[Makeb]]'s [[volcanic mesa]]. Vorjok was visibly angry at the incompetence of the local [[InterStellar Regulators]], who failed to increase security even after several seismic shocks rocked the mesa, believing them mere groundquakes. Shortly after, an Imperial team led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Cytharat]] assaulted the stronghold and even though Vorjok boasted of having killed Force-users before, he was promptly defeated.
